title: Observer history for the gen9ou joint opponent model

opponent_id.description: Use a separate belief instance for each opponent; new_game preserves this player's memory.

observer_team.description: Our own original Showdown sets; available to mechanics inference, never directly to the opponent policy.

opponent_preview.description: Public species in preview order; no true hidden opponent sets.

public_events.description: Public protocol before the first decision, including preview details.

seed.description: Research inference seed; not the simulator's hidden battle RNG.

windows.description: Chronological complete simulator resolution windows, including separate forced-switch decisions; do not split a damage packet into independent evidence.

our_submitted_action.description: Our already submitted command used only for mechanics settlement.

observer_private_events.description: The same resolution window in our legal private view, e.g. exact own HP. Not the opponent's private log.

sequence.description: Zero-based window index; replacing an earlier index replays the affected history.
